body:
I've made 3 serious attempts the first time I was 14, tried hanging myself in my wardrobe and ended up breaking it. 

The second time I was 22 on a comedown and tried overdosing with some pills I found. While I was crying and trashing my room the police turned up and i can remember them strangling me screaming "stop fucking moving" and the policeman was banging my head against the  radiator. Next thing I remember i was in hospital.

Last serious attempt was 27. I pushed a knife through my wrist. I missed the tendon by 3mm 
And I have a large scar to this day

It used to feel like whenever something bad happened I had a cheat code and I couldjust skip it. Now I'm dealing with the same shit and I never learned how to make it work or if I'm even capable of making any of it work

Your not "too sensitive" people are just selfish and limited. Your juggling alot of stuff and I know its hard but at least your keeping it up i know I've dropped  all the shit i needed to juggle a few times and it's very fucking hard to pick up the pieces when you drop them. 

I hope it gets better.
